Daily Quiz.question: ১) Who is the author of 'Song of Solomon'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Toni Morrison, American writer noted for her examination of Black experience (particularly Black female experience) within the Black community. She received the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1993. His notable works: The Bluest Eye, Beloved, Sula, The Book About Mean People, A Mercy, Playing in the Dark: Whiteness and the Literary Imagination, Home, Song of Solomon, Paradise.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) Mrs. Dalloway is a novel by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Virginia woolf was female novelist. She is famous for presentation of inner realities. Her famous novels are: The Voyage Out (first novel), To The Light house, Mrs. Dalloway, A Room of One's Own, The Waves, Flush, The Years, Orlando: A biography etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) What kind of literary work is 'The Ant and the Grasshopper' by William Somerset Maugham?
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Somerset Maugham is a English novelist, playwright and story writer. The Ant and the Grasshopper, The Luncheon are the short story of William Somerset Maugham. His famous Novels are Of Human Bondage, The Sacred Flames, The Razor's Edge, Cakes and Ale, The Musician, The Moon and Sixpence, Lady Frederick.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Winston Churchill was awarded nobel prize for Literature in-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Winston Churchill, British statesman, orator, and author who as prime minister (1940–45, 1951–55) rallied the British people during World War II and led his country from the brink of defeat to victory.
- His famous book is The Second World War.
- He was awarded nobel prize for Literature in 1953 for writing the history of the Second World War.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Who wrote the poem 'The Waste Land'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
T. S. Elliot is an American Born British poet Dramatist and Social Critic. He is famous for his Theory of Objective correlatives. Famous poem of T.S. Eliot are The Waste Land, Journey to the Magi, Ash Wednesday, Four Quarters, The Hollow Man, Portrait of a Lady. His famous drama are Murder in Cathedral, The Family Reunion, The Cocktail Party, The Elder Statement.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) 'The Good Earth' deals with-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Pearl S. Buck is a famous American female novelist and writer. She awarded Nobel Prize in 1938 for her rich and truly epic description of peasant life in China (The Good Earth). She was the first American woman to win the Nobel Prize for literature. His famous works: The Good Earth, Pavilion of Women, Imperial Women, A House Divided.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Who is the author of 'Riders to The Sea'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
John Millington Synge was an Irish Dramatist. His famous works are Riders to The Sea (one act play), In the Shadow of the Glen, The Well of the Saints, The Playboy of the Western World, The Tinker's Wedding.
Source: An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Who is the author of the book 'To the Light House'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Virginia woolf was female novelist. She is famous for presentation of inner realities. Her famous novels are: The Voyage Out (first novel), To The Light house, Mrs. Dalloway, A Room of One's Own, The Waves, Flush, The Years, Orlando: A biography etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Who is the author of 'As I Lay Dying'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Faulkner is an American novelist and writer. His famous works: The sound and fury, As I Lay Dying, Absalom, Absalom!, A Rose for Emile, Light in August, The Hamlet (novel), Go Down Moses.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) 'Of Human Bondage' is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Somerset Maugham is a English novelist, playwright and story writer. His famous Novels are Of Human Bondage, The Sacred Flames, The Razor's Edge, Cakes and Ale, The Musician, The Moon and Sixpence, Lady Frederick.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Leo Tolstoy is a _____ novelist.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Leo Tolstoy is a Russian one of the greatest writers. His famous novels: War and Peace, Anna Karenina, Childhood, Resurrection etc and drama- The Power of Darkness.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Who is the author of the Novel 'Les Miserable'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Victor Hugo is a French Poet, novelist and dramatist. His famous Novels: Les Miserable, Ninety-Three, The Hunchback of Notre Dame (First Novel), The Man Who Laugh and Poem: Autumn Leaves, Songs of the Twilight, Inner Voice, Rays and Shadows etc.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) 'Passage to India' was written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Walt Whitman is an American poet, essayist and journalist.
His famous works:
- Passage To India (poem),
- Leaves of Grass,
- Drum-Taps,
- O Captain! My Captain,
- Songs of Myself.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Poem analysis website.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Who wrote the book 'The Mysterious Island'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Jules Verne is a French novelist, poet and playwright. His famous works: Around the World in Eighty Days, The Mysterious Island, From the Earth to Moon, Around the Moon, Off on a Comet, Master of the World.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) Who wrote the novel 'The Mother'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Maxim Gorky is a Russian-Soviet writer. He is founder of Socialist realism literature method. He was five time nominee for Nobel Prize in literature. His famous novels: The Mother, My Children, In the World.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) What was the real name of the great American Short story writer, O' Henry?
Daily Quiz.exp:
O' Henry was an American famous short story writer. His original name was William Sidney Porter. O' Henry is his Penname. He is famous for his story The Gift of the Magi. Samuel Langhorne Clemens is the real name of Mark Twain and Mary Ann Evans is the real name of George Eliot.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) Who is the author of 'Life on Mississippi'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Samuel Langhorne Clemens is the real name of Mark Twain. Life on Mississippi, The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and The Adventures of Tom Sawyer are his famous books.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Who is the author of 'Candide'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Voltaire, pseudonym of Francois-Marie Arouet, one of the greatest of all French writers. His famous works: Candide, Mahomet, L’Histoire de Charles XII, La Prude, Zadig, Memnon, Oedipe, The Tragedy of Zara, La Henriade.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Who wrote 'The Wild Swans at Coole'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Butler Yeats is an Irish dramatist, poet and critic. He wrote the preamble of Tagore's 'Gitanjali' in 1912, which later got nobel prize in 1913. W. B. Yeats got nobel prize in 1923. His famous poems: The Wild Swans at Coole, The Tower, The Winding Stair and Other Poems, The Resurrection, The Second Coming, The Cat and The Moon, The Lake Isle of Innisfree, Among School Children, The Lord of Harts, Falling of Leaves, A prayer for My Daughter, When You Are Old.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Who is the author of 'Midsummer Night'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
John Masefield was a British poet and writer. His famous works: Midsummer Night, End and Beginning, Midnight Folk, The Everlasting Mercy, Collected Poems.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ২১) Who was awarded the Nobel Prize for Literature, but declined it?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Jean-Paul Sartre, French novelist, playwright, and exponent of Existentialism—a philosophy acclaiming the freedom of the individual human being. He was awarded the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1964, but he declined it. His famous works: No Exit, Nausea, Saint Genet, Actor and Martyr, The Words, Flaubert, Situations, The Flies, The Psychology of Imagination, Being and Nothingness.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২২) Who is the writer of 'Lord Jim'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Joseph Conrad was born of an aristocratic polish parents in Ukraine. His famous works: Lord Jim, Heart of Darkness, The End of the Theter, Typhoon, Nostromo, The Mirror of the Sea, The Secret Agent, The Nigger of the Narcissus, Chance, Victory, Under Western Eyes, The Shadow Line, The Rescue, The Rover.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৩) 'Waiting for Godot' is a/an-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Samuel Beckett is an Irish dramatist. He died in France. He was awarded Nobel prize in 1969. His absurd drama is Waiting for Godot. His famous plays: Endgame, Murphy, Molloy, Malone Bias, The Unnamable.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৪) R.K. Narayan is a/an _____ writer.
Daily Quiz.exp:
R.K. Narayan, in full Rasipuram Krishnaswami Narayan, original name Rasipuram Krishnaswami Narayanswami, one of the finest Indian authors of his generation writing in English. His famous works: The Dark Room, The Financial Expert, The Guide, A Tiger for Malgudi, Swami and Friends.
Source: An ABC of English Literature and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৫) Who wrote the novel 'Lord of the Flies'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Gerald Golding was a British novelist, dramatist and poet. He was awarded nobel prize in 1983 for Lord of the Flies. His famous novels: Lord of the Flies, Darkness Visible, The Pyramid, The Scorpion God Free Fall.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৬) 'The Bluest Eye' was written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Toni Morrison, American writer noted for her examination of Black experience (particularly Black female experience) within the Black community. She received the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1993. His notable works: The Bluest Eye, Beloved, Sula, The Book About Mean People, A Mercy, Playing in the Dark: Whiteness and the Literary Imagination, Home, Song of Solomon, Paradise.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৭) Who is the author of 'The Jungle Book'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Rudyard Kipling Born in India. He is the first British to won Nobel prize in 1907.
He is mainly a Short Story writer.

His famous works are:
- The Jungle Book (Short Story),
- Kim,
- Just So Stories,
- Puck of Pook's Hill,
- Rewards and Fairies,
- Plain Tales from The Hills,
- Departmental Ditties,
- The Tomb of His Ancestors,
- The Man who was,
- The Mark of the Beast,
- Soldiers Three etc.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৮) Who wrote the poem 'Stopping by Woods On a Snowy Evening'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Robert Frost is American National poet. His famous poems: Stopping by Woods On a Snowy Evening, Nothing Gold Can Stay, After Apple-Picking, Road Not Taken, Mending Wall, Christmas Trees, Home Burial, A Way Out (one act play) etc.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৯) T.S. Elliot was born in-
Daily Quiz.exp:
T. S. Elliot is an American Born British poet, dramatist and social critic. He is famous for his 'Theory of Objective Correlative'. His famous drama Murder in Cathedral, The Family Reunion, The Cocktail Party, The Elder Statement. His famous poems are The Waste Land, Journey to the Magi, Ash Wednesday, Four Quarters, The Hollow Man, Portrait of a Lady.
Source:
Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩০) Famous Irish poet and dramatist is-
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Butler Yeats is an Irish dramatist, poet and critic. He wrote the preamble of Tagore's 'Gitanjali' in 1912, which later got nobel prize in 1913. W. B. Yeats got nobel prize in 1923. His famous poems: The Wild Swans at Coole, The Tower, The Winding Stair and Other Poems, The Resurrection, The Second Coming, The Cat and The Moon, The Lake Isle of Innisfree, Among School Children, The Lord of Harts, Falling of Leaves, A prayer for My Daughter, When You Are Old.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.
